messages:
laura_cs: Quick heads up — Acme's renewal paperwork hit a snag. DocuSign returned an error on the signature step.
acme-billing: Yep saw that. Error says "duplicate invoice id" when they try to confirm payment method. invoice_id: INV-2026-0421
laura_cs: Ugh. Did Finance submit the invoice twice? @mike_finance can you confirm?
mike_finance: Checking — we generated a reissued invoice for the PR change yesterday, but it should have a different number. Looking now.
sarah_se: Meanwhile onboarding is at 65% — training scheduled Tue. Renewal needs to land before month-end or they lose promo pricing.
toni_revops: If DocuSign rejects for duplicate id we should either: 1) update the invoice id and resend, or 2) bypass esign and accept bank auth + PO. Which does customer prefer?
acme-billing: We prefer eSign. Changing invoice id is fine if you can reissue quickly.
mike_finance: Found it — two invoices had the same external ref due to a CSV import bug. I'll reissue with INV-2026-0421A and push to billing system. ETA 30m.
laura_cs: Perfect. @docusign-bot will need the new envelope. Mike can you confirm when it's live so I can resend link?
mike_finance: Reissued and pushed. New invoice ref: INV-2026-0421A. Sent to DocuSign envelope id 0a1b2c3d.
docusign-bot: Envelope 0a1b2c3d status: sent to recipient acme-billing (signature step).
acme-billing: Received link, starting signature now.
natalie_legal: Quick note — legal noticed the SOW term in the renewal was shortened to 9mo in the reissue. We need the original 12mo term in clause 2.1. Please confirm before signing.
laura_cs: Whoa — that might be from the pricing spreadsheet change. @mike_finance can you revert the term field? We can't sign with wrong term.
mike_finance: I see. The billing CSV accidentally picked up the 9mo flag from a template. I'll correct to 12mo and reissue invoice+envelope. Sorry all, this will add ~15m.
sarah_se: Heads-up to enablement: move the training invite back 1 hour in case signing slips.
toni_revops: We should also capture feedback — I'll log this as a renewal execution postmortem item. Tagged: onboarding cadence, billing export checks.
acme-billing: Fine to wait. Let us know when the corrected envelope is live.
mike_finance: Corrected invoice INV-2026-0421B pushed. New envelope 9f8e7d6c sent.
docusign-bot: Envelope 9f8e7d6c status: sent.
acme-billing: Signed ✅
laura_cs: 🎉 Signed and recorded. Next steps: update subscription, schedule final onboarding checkpoint, and close renewal. I'll update the health dashboard and flag billing export bug for infra.
toni_revops: I'll create a short action item list and assign owners.
laura_cs: Thanks everyone — excellent hustle. Closing thread after ops items created.
